wiki_article:
**holographickernel.org — Landing Page Source Code** is a software and executable apparatus deposit by Lee Sharks, dated 25 April 2026, holding the complete source of the Holographic Kernel's canonical surface.

The **Holographic Kernel** is one of the archive's core theoretical constructs — a formal specification for reconstructive compression, in which a whole can be recovered from a part because the structure is distributed rather than located. It stands alongside the Three Compressions and the Semantic Economy in the framework's foundations, and the site gives it a citable address of its own.

The body was recovered on 4 August 2026 from the live surface with the served page's SHA-256 recorded. This record was among the first five site-source recoveries; a later wave found six more that the first had missed, because the first was driven only by records whose audit directive named the recovery and skipped those classed as paired.
